description: This file defines a benchmark test class for capturing a baseline profile of app startup performance in an Android project. It uses the Android benchmarking framework to generate a profile that helps optimize app launch time by collecting usage data during startup.

classes.name: StartupBaselineProfile
classes.description: A test class that collects a baseline profile for app startup performance, enabling optimizations like Dex layout improvements.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: A test method that invokes the collection of a baseline profile during app startup, using the specified profile block.
